title: Berkeley Rent Ordinance rent control coverage
requirement: Rent control limits rent increases on most units in multifamily properties built before 1980 and on single family homes and rooming houses with tenancies that began before 1996. New construction after June 1980, most condominiums and certain subsidized units are not rent-controlled.
coverage_conditions: Most units in multifamily properties built before 1980, and single family homes and rooming houses with tenancies that began before 1996, are rent-controlled. New construction after June 1980, most condominiums and certain subsidized units are not.

conditions.text: most condominiums and units with certain government subsidies are not rent-controlled

applicability.per_tenancy: Single family homes and rooming houses: rent control only where the tenancy began before 1996; ADU tenancies started after November 7, 2018 with an owner-occupied unit are exempt.

exemptions: Golden Duplex (duplex owner-occupied on December 31, 1979 with an owner living in one unit); units where the owner shares a kitchen or bath with the tenant; ADU tenancies started after Nov 7, 2018 where either unit is owner-occupied; university dormitories; nonprofit cooperatives.

title: Berkeley Rent Ordinance just cause eviction coverage
requirement: A landlord may evict only for just cause from any unit covered by the ordinance. Just cause applies to both fully covered and partially covered units, even where rent control does not.
coverage_conditions: Just cause for eviction applies to all units covered by the ordinance, including partially covered units built after June 1980, most condominiums, homes with tenancies from 1996 on and certain subsidized units. Exempt units are not covered.

applicability.per_tenancy: Exempt: a unit where the owner shares a kitchen or bath with the tenant; tenancies started after November 7, 2018 on properties where one unit is an ADU and either unit is owner-occupied.

title: Berkeley Rent Ordinance security deposit interest coverage
requirement: Tenants in units covered by the ordinance, whether fully or partially covered, are entitled to interest on their security deposits. Tenants in exempt units are not.
coverage_conditions: Security deposit interest applies to units fully or partially covered by the ordinance, including partially covered units built after June 1980, most condominiums, homes with tenancies from 1996 on and certain subsidized units. Exempt units get no interest.
